source: Buy 5 USDC of MON daily for 30 days, max 1% slippage, send the MON to bob

clauses.text: spends at most 5 USDC at a time
clauses.because: Checked on every spend. A larger request is refused as OVER_ACTION_CAP.

clauses.text: once a day, and no more often
clauses.because: One window per period. An unused window is forfeited, not banked — a skipped day cannot be spent later.
After the last window the capsule refuses everything as WINDOWS_EXHAUSTED.
Fixed at mint. The agent chooses the venue, never the asset.
The floor the agent commits to must sit inside this, and the measured fill must clear that floor.

clauses.text: never more than 10 USDC in one go, whatever anyone approves
clauses.because: Nothing lifts this. Not an escalation, not the issuer, not a compromised backend.
The most that can ever move through this capsule.
Any other venue is refused as TARGET_NOT_ALLOWED, whatever calldata the agent supplies.

clauses.text: sends the proceeds to the recipient
clauses.because: Checked against the request on every spend, so the agent cannot pay itself.
